```{r version, include=FALSE}
radius_version <- "2026_10"
taxonomy <- "COL"

stopifnot(taxonomy %in% c("GBIF", "COL"))

code_column <- switch(
  taxonomy,
  GBIF = "GBIF_code",
  COL = "COL_code"
)

species_join <- setNames(code_column, "speciesKey")

dir.create(
  here::here("radius", "data", "output", radius_version),
  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE
)
```


```{r function-multisurface-to-multipolygon}
ensure_multipolygons <- function(X) {
  tmp1 <- tempfile(fileext = ".gpkg")
  tmp2 <- tempfile(fileext = ".gpkg")
  st_write(X, tmp1)
  ogr2ogr(tmp1, tmp2, f = "GPKG", nlt = "MULTIPOLYGON")
  Y <- st_read(tmp2)
  st_sf(st_drop_geometry(X), geom = st_geometry(Y))
}

ensure_multilinestrings <- function(X) {
  tmp1 <- tempfile(fileext = ".gpkg")
  tmp2 <- tempfile(fileext = ".gpkg")
  st_write(X, tmp1)
  ogr2ogr(tmp1, tmp2, f = "GPKG", nlt = "MULTILINESTRING")
  Y <- st_read(tmp2)
  st_sf(st_drop_geometry(X), geom = st_geometry(Y))
}
```

# Read data into R

```{r import-species-list}
species_list <- read_csv(
  here::here("radius", "data", "input", radius_version, "radius_species_list.csv"),
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
)

species_abbr <- read_csv2(
  here::here("radius", "data", "input", radius_version, "species_abbr.csv"),
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
)
```

```{r import-species-occ}
occ_flanders <- read_csv(
  here::here("radius", "data", "input", radius_version, "gbif_occ_flanders.csv"),
  col_types = cols(speciesKey = col_character())
) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("Soort", "Species", "abbr"))) %>%
  left_join(
    species_list %>% select(all_of(code_column), Soort, Species),
    by = species_join,
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )


occ_flanders <- occ_flanders %>%
  left_join(
    species_abbr %>% select(Soort, abbr),
    by = "Soort",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

occ_flanders <- occ_flanders %>%
  select(
    year, month, day,
    decimalLongitude, decimalLatitude,
    speciesKey, Soort, Species,
    abbr
  ) %>%
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"),
    crs = 4326
  ) %>%
  st_transform(31370)
```

# Inlezen spatial data from local location
```{r load-data, include=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# HABITATRICHTLIJN
### habitatrichtlijnkaart (incl. deelgebieden)
ps_hbtrl_deel <- st_read(
  here::here("radius", "data", "spatial", "ps_hbtrl_deel.shp")
)

### habitatrichtlijnkaart (excl. deelgebieden)
ps_hbtrl <- ps_hbtrl_deel %>%
  group_by(gebcode, naam, gebopp_ha) %>%
  summarise(geometry = sf::st_union(geometry)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  st_transform(4326) %>%
  st_as_sf()

# VOGELRICHTLIJN
ps_vglrl <- st_read(
  here::here("radius", "data", "spatial", "ps_vglrl.shp")
) %>%
  mutate(oppervlakte = round(as.numeric(st_area(geometry))/10000, 1))

# N2000 HABITATS
n2khab <- st_read(
  here::here("radius", "data", "spatial", "n2khab.shp")
)

# Natuurbeheerplannen
ps_nbhp <- st_read(
  here::here("radius", "data", "spatial", "ps_nbhp.shp")
)

# ANB patrimonium
am_patdat <- st_read(
  here::here("radius", "data", "spatial", "am_patdat.shp")
)
```

# Soortenbeschermingsprogramma's (SBPs)
```{r}
wfs_ANB <- "https://www.mercator.vlaanderen.be/raadpleegdienstenmercatorpubliek/wfs"

url <- parse_url(wfs_ANB)
url$query <- list(
  service = "WFS",
  version = "2.0.0",
  request = "GetFeature",
  typename = "lu:lu_sbp_pls",
  srsName = "EPSG:31370"
)

request <- build_url(url)

lu_sbp_pls <- st_read(request, as_tibble = FALSE, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_set_crs(31370) %>%
  ensure_multilinestrings()

lu_sbp_pls_wgs84 <- lu_sbp_pls %>%
  st_transform(4326)

lu_sbp_pls_buffered <- lu_sbp_pls %>%
  st_buffer(dist = 10) %>%
  group_by(soort, type) %>%
  summarize(geom = st_union(geom), .groups = "drop")

#st_write(lu_sbp_pls, "./radius/data/spatial/lu_sbp_pls.shp", append = FALSE)

url$query <- list(
  service = "WFS",
  version = "2.0.0",
  request = "GetFeature",
  typename = "lu:lu_sbp_pgs",
  srsName = "EPSG:31370"
)

request <- build_url(url)

lu_sbp_pgs <- st_read(request, as_tibble = FALSE, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_set_crs(31370) %>%
  ensure_multipolygons()

#st_write(lu_sbp_pgs, "./radius/data/spatial/lu_sbp_pgs.shp", append = FALSE)
```

# TEST 16/10

# Calculating occupancy metrics
```{r calculate-occupancy-metrics, warning=FALSE}
# list wfs-maps
list.dfs <- list(
  HBTRL = ps_hbtrl_deel,
  VGLRL = ps_vglrl,
  N2KHAB = n2khab,
  PATDAT_incl_ob = am_patdat,
  PATDAT_excl_ob = am_patdat_excl_ob,
  NBHP = ps_nbhp,
  SBP_pls = lu_sbp_pls_buffered,
  SBP_pgs = lu_sbp_pgs,
  TOP3 = data.frame(), 
  VL = data.frame()
)

# initialize a list for results
list.results <- lapply(list.dfs, function(x) data.frame(
  soort = character(), species = character(), abbr = character(),
  gebied = character(), overlap = character(), type = character()
))

# loop through unique species
for (i in unique(occ_flanders$Soort)) {
  print(i)
  
  # Selecteer uitsluitend de milieukolommen van deze soort.
  milieuwaarden <- toewijzing_soorten %>%
    filter(soort == i) %>%
    select(all_of(milieus)) %>%
    unlist(use.names = FALSE)
  soort_milieu <- milieus[milieuwaarden == 1]
  if (length(soort_milieu) == 0) {
    stop("Geen milieu toegewezen aan: ", i)
  }

  # Behoud habitattypes die bij minstens één toegewezen milieu passen.
  n2khab_subset <- toewijzing_habitats %>%
    filter(if_any(all_of(soort_milieu), ~ .x == 1)) %>%
    pull(code)

  # extract species occurrence
  occ_species <- occ_flanders[occ_flanders$Soort == i,]
  
  # add buffer around species occurrences + union
  occ_species_buf <- occ_species %>%
    st_buffer(dist = 100) %>%
    st_union() %>% 
    st_cast('POLYGON') %>% 
    st_sf() %>%
    mutate(buf_area = as.numeric(st_area(.))) 
  
  total_area <- sum(occ_species_buf$buf_area)
  
  list.results[[10]] <- rbind(list.results[[10]], data.frame(
    soort = i,
    species = paste(unique(occ_species$Species), collapse = ","), 
    abbr = unique(na.omit(occ_species$abbr)), 
    gebied = "VL",
    overlap = format(round(total_area / Vlaanderen_grenzen$OPPERVL,6), scientific = FALSE),
    type = "of"
  ))
  
  # loop through wfs-maps to calculate occupancy metrics
  for (j in seq_along(list.dfs[1:6])) {
    print(j)
    # transform CRS to Lambert 72 to use st_buffer with meters instead of decimal degrees
    gebied <- list.dfs[[j]] %>%
      st_transform(31370) %>%
      mutate(geb_area = as.numeric(st_area(.)))
    
    gebied_summary <- gebied %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      select(code = if (j == 1) "gebcode" else if (j == 2) "na2000code" else if (j == 3) "type" else if (j %in% c(4,5)) "regio_abb" else "egndmty_abb", geb_area) %>%
      group_by(code) %>%
      summarise(geb_area = as.numeric(sum(geb_area)))
    
    if (j == 3) {
      gebied <- gebied %>%
        filter(type %in% n2khab_subset)
    }
    
    # intersection buffered occurrences with wfs-map
    occ_species_intersection <- occ_species_buf %>%
      st_intersection(gebied) %>% 
      mutate(intersect_area = as.numeric(st_area(.)))
    
    overlap_intersection <- sum(occ_species_intersection$intersect_area)
    percentage_overlap_in <- overlap_intersection / total_area
    percentage_overlap_of <- overlap_intersection / sum(gebied$geb_area)

    
    if (nrow(occ_species_intersection) != 0) {  # skip following steps if there's no overlap 
      # Standard occupancy metrics across all wfs-maps
      print("standard metrics")
      metrics_df <- data.frame(
        soort = i,
        species = paste(unique(occ_species$Species), collapse = ","), 
        abbr = unique(na.omit(occ_species$abbr)),
        gebied = names(list.dfs)[j],
        overlap = format(round(c(percentage_overlap_in, percentage_overlap_of), 6), scientific = FALSE), 
        type = paste0(c("in", "of")))
      
      list.results[[j]] <- rbind(list.results[[j]], metrics_df)
      
      # additional occupancy metrics for HBTRL (i = 1), VGLRL (i = 2), N2KHAB (i = 3)
      if (j %in% c(1, 2, 3)) {
        print("additional metrics hbtrl, vglrl, n2khab")
        # overlap percentage per gebied 
        overlap_per_gebied <- occ_species_intersection %>%
          group_by(code = if (j == 2) na2000code else if (j == 3) type else gebcode) %>%
          summarise(intersect_area = sum(intersect_area)) %>%
          st_drop_geometry() %>%
          full_join(gebied_summary, by = "code") %>%
          mutate(intersect_area = replace_na(intersect_area, 0))
        
        for (row in seq_len(nrow(overlap_per_gebied))) {
          # OPTIE 1: percentage van overlap dat in bepaald gebied valt
          # percentage_overlap_in = as.numeric(overlap_per_gebied[row,]$intersect_area / overlap_intersection)
          # OPTIE 2: percentage van totale verspreiding dat in bepaald gebied valt
          percentage_overlap_in = overlap_per_gebied[row,]$intersect_area / total_area
          
          # percentage van oppervlakte HBTRL/VLRL/BWKHAB gebied dat overlapt met soortverspreiding
          percentage_overlap_of = overlap_per_gebied[row,]$intersect_area / overlap_per_gebied[row,]$geb_area

          
          metrics_df <- data.frame(
            soort = i,
            species = paste(unique(occ_species$Species), collapse = ","), 
            abbr = unique(na.omit(occ_species$abbr)), 
            gebied = as.character(overlap_per_gebied[row,1]),
            overlap = format(round(c(percentage_overlap_in, percentage_overlap_of), 6), scientific = FALSE), 
            type = paste0(c("in", "of")))
          
          list.results[[j]] <- rbind(list.results[[j]], metrics_df)
        }
      }
      
      # additional occupancy metrics for PATDAT (i = c(4,5))
      if (j %in% c(4,5)) {
        print("additional metrics patdat")
        # totaal aantal domeinen waarmee verspreiding overlapt
        list.results[[j]] <- rbind(list.results[[j]], data.frame(
          soort = i,
          species = paste(unique(occ_species$Species), collapse = ","), 
          abbr = unique(na.omit(occ_species$abbr)),
          gebied = names(list.dfs)[j],
          overlap = length(unique(occ_species_intersection$id)), 
          type = "n_domeinen"))
        
        # aantal bezette domeinen per type recht anb
        anb_rechten <- occ_species_intersection %>%
          st_drop_geometry() %>%
          select(id, rchtnnb, rchtnnb_abb) %>%
          unique() %>%
          group_by(rchtnnb_abb) %>%
          summarise(n = n()) 
        
        for (row in seq_len(nrow(anb_rechten))) {
          list.results[[j]] <- rbind(list.results[[j]], data.frame(
            soort = i,
            species = paste(unique(occ_species$Species), collapse = ","), 
            abbr = unique(na.omit(occ_species$abbr)),
            gebied = as.character(anb_rechten[row,1]),
            overlap = as.character(anb_rechten[row,2]), 
            type = "anb_rechten"))
        }
        print("domeinen per anb recht: DONE")
        # percentage overlap per anb regio
        overlap_per_anb_regio <- occ_species_intersection %>%
          st_drop_geometry() %>%
          select(regio_abb, intersect_area) %>%
          unique() %>%
          group_by(regio_abb) %>%
          summarise(intersect_area = sum(intersect_area)) %>%
          arrange() %>%
          full_join(gebied_summary, by = c("regio_abb" = "code")) %>%
          filter(!is.na(regio_abb)) %>%
          mutate(intersect_area = replace_na(intersect_area, 0))
        
        for (row in seq_len(nrow(overlap_per_anb_regio))) {
          # OPTIE 1: percentage van overlap met PATDAT per anb regio
          #percentage_overlap_in = as.numeric(overlap_per_anb_regio[row,]$intersect_area / overlap_intersection)
          # OPTIE 2: percentage van totale verspreiding dat overlapt per anb regio
          percentage_overlap_in = overlap_per_anb_regio[row,]$intersect_area / total_area
          
          percentage_overlap_of = overlap_per_anb_regio[row,]$intersect_area / overlap_per_anb_regio[row,]$geb_area


          metrics_df <- data.frame(
            soort = i,
            species = paste(unique(occ_species$Species), collapse = ","), 
            abbr = unique(na.omit(occ_species$abbr)),
            gebied = as.character(overlap_per_anb_regio[row,1]),
            overlap = format(round(c(percentage_overlap_in, percentage_overlap_of), 6), scientific = FALSE), 
            type = paste0(c("in", "of")))
          
          list.results[[j]] <- rbind(list.results[[j]], metrics_df)
        }
        print("overlap per ANB regio: DONE")
      }
      
      # additional occupancy metrics for NBHP (i = 6)
      if (j == 6) {
        print("additional metrics nbhp")
        # totaal aantal gebieden waarmee verspreiding overlapt
        list.results[[j]] <- rbind(list.results[[j]], data.frame(
          soort = i,
          species = paste(unique(occ_species$Species), collapse = ","), 
          abbr = unique(na.omit(occ_species$abbr)),
          gebied = names(list.dfs)[j],
          overlap = as.character(length(unique(occ_species_intersection$id))), 
          type = "n_nbhp"))
        
        # aantal bezette domeinen per type natuurbeheerplan
        n_per_beheerplantype <- occ_species_intersection %>%
          st_drop_geometry() %>%
          select(id, ntrbhrp, ntrbhrp_abb) %>%
          unique() %>%
          group_by(ntrbhrp_abb) %>%
          summarise(n = n())
        
        for (row in seq_len(nrow(n_per_beheerplantype))) {
          list.results[[j]] <- rbind(list.results[[j]], data.frame(
            soort = i,
            species = paste(unique(occ_species$Species), collapse = ","), 
            abbr = unique(na.omit(occ_species$abbr)),
            gebied = as.character(n_per_beheerplantype[row,1]),
            overlap = as.character(n_per_beheerplantype[row,2]), 
            type = paste0(c("n_per_type"))))
        }
        print("aantal domeinen per nbhptype: DONE")
        
        # percentage overlap per eigendomtype
        overlap_per_egndmty <- occ_species_intersection %>%
          st_drop_geometry() %>%
          select(egndmty_abb, intersect_area) %>%
          unique() %>%
          group_by(egndmty_abb) %>%
          summarise(intersect_area = sum(intersect_area)) %>%
          arrange() %>%
          full_join(gebied_summary, by = c("egndmty_abb" = "code")) %>%
          mutate(intersect_area = replace_na(intersect_area, 0))
        
        for (row in seq_len(nrow(overlap_per_egndmty))) {
          # OPTIE 1: percentage van overlap met NBHP dat overlapt per eigendomtype
          # percentage_overlap_in = as.numeric(overlap_per_egndmty[row,]$intersect_area / overlap_intersection)
          # OPTIE 2: percentage van totale verspreiding dat overlapt per eigendomtype
          percentage_overlap_in = overlap_per_egndmty[row,]$intersect_area / total_area
          percentage_overlap_of = overlap_per_egndmty[row,]$intersect_area / overlap_per_egndmty[row,]$geb_area
          
          metrics_df <- data.frame(
            soort = i,
            species = paste(unique(occ_species$Species), collapse = ","), 
            abbr = unique(na.omit(occ_species$abbr)), 
            gebied = as.character(overlap_per_egndmty[row,1]),
            overlap = format(round(c(percentage_overlap_in, percentage_overlap_of), 6), scientific = FALSE), 
            type = paste0(c("in", "of")))
          
          list.results[[j]] <- rbind(list.results[[j]], metrics_df)
        } 
        print("overlap per eigendomtype: DONE")
      }
      
      # Top 3 gebieden voor HBTRL, VGLRL, NBHP
      if (j %in% c(1,2,6)) {
        print("top 3 hbtrl, vglrl, nbhp")
        top_3 <- occ_species_intersection %>%
          group_by(naam = if (j == 2) gebnaam else if (j == 6) namdssr else naam) %>%
          summarise(intersect_area = sum(intersect_area)) %>%
          slice_max(order_by = intersect_area, n = 3, na_rm = TRUE) %>%
          st_drop_geometry()
        
        for (row in seq_len(nrow(top_3))) {
          list.results[[9]] <- rbind(list.results[[9]], data.frame(
            soort = i,
            species = paste(unique(occ_species$Species), collapse = ","), 
            abbr = unique(na.omit(occ_species$abbr)),
            gebied = as.character(top_3[row, 1]),
            overlap = top_3$intersect_area[row],
            type = names(list.dfs)[j]))
        }
      }
      
      # Top 3 anb regio's en domeinen
      if (j %in% c(4,5)) {
        print("top 3 patdat")
        top_3_regio <- occ_species_intersection %>%
          group_by(regio) %>%
          summarise(intersect_area = sum(intersect_area)) %>%
          slice_max(order_by = intersect_area, n = 3, na_rm = TRUE) %>%
          st_drop_geometry()
        
        for (row in seq_len(nrow(top_3_regio))) {
          list.results[[9]] <- rbind(list.results[[9]], data.frame(
            soort = i,
            species = paste(unique(occ_species$Species), collapse = ","), 
            abbr = unique(na.omit(occ_species$abbr)),
            gebied = as.character(top_3_regio[row, 1]),
            overlap = top_3_regio$intersect_area[row],
            type = "anb-regio"))
        }
        print("top 3 anb regio: DONE")
        
        top_3_domein <- occ_species_intersection %>%
          group_by(domennm) %>%
          summarise(intersect_area = sum(intersect_area)) %>%
          slice_max(order_by = intersect_area, n = 3, na_rm = TRUE) %>%
          st_drop_geometry()
        
        for (row in seq_len(nrow(top_3_domein))) {
          list.results[[9]] <- rbind(list.results[[9]], data.frame(
            soort = i,
            species = paste(unique(occ_species$Species), collapse = ","), 
            abbr = unique(na.omit(occ_species$abbr)),
            gebied = as.character(top_3_domein[row, 1]),
            overlap = top_3_domein$intersect_area[row],
            type = "anb-domein"))
        }
        print("top 3 anb domein: DONE")
      }
    }
    
    else {  # create empty row if there's no overlap 
      metrics_df <- data.frame(
        soort = i,
        species = paste(unique(occ_species$Species), collapse = ","), 
        abbr = unique(na.omit(occ_species$abbr)),
        gebied = names(list.dfs)[j],
        overlap = "0", 
        type = paste0(c("in", "of")))
      
      list.results[[j]] <- rbind(list.results[[j]], metrics_df)
    }
  }
  
  for (j in 7:8) {
    print(j)
    gebied <- list.dfs[[j]] %>%
      st_transform(31370) %>%
      mutate(geb_area = as.numeric(st_area(.)))
    
    for (k in unique(gebied$soort)) {
      print(k)
      gebied_sbp <- gebied %>%
        filter(soort == k)
      
      occ_species_intersection <- occ_species_buf %>%
        st_intersection(gebied_sbp) %>% 
        mutate(intersect_area = as.numeric(st_area(.)))
      
      overlap_intersection <- sum(occ_species_intersection$intersect_area)
      percentage_overlap_in <- overlap_intersection / total_area
      percentage_overlap_of <- overlap_intersection / sum(gebied_sbp$geb_area)

      
      metrics_df <- data.frame(
        soort = i,
        species = paste(unique(occ_species$Species), collapse = ","), 
        abbr = unique(na.omit(occ_species$abbr)),
        gebied = paste("SBP ", k),
        overlap = format(round(c(percentage_overlap_in, percentage_overlap_of), 6), scientific = FALSE), 
        type = paste0(c("in", "of")))
      
      list.results[[j]] <- rbind(list.results[[j]], metrics_df)
      
      if (nrow(occ_species_intersection) != 0 & j == 8) { 
        overlap_per_gebied <- occ_species_intersection %>%
          st_drop_geometry() %>%
          group_by(gebied, geb_area) %>%
          summarise(intersect_area = sum(intersect_area)) %>%
          ungroup() %>%
          full_join(gebied %>% filter(soort == k) %>% st_drop_geometry(), by = c("gebied", "geb_area")) %>%
          select(gebied, geb_area, intersect_area) %>%
          mutate(intersect_area = replace_na(intersect_area, 0))
        
        for (row in seq_len(nrow(overlap_per_gebied))) {
          percentage_overlap_in = overlap_per_gebied[row,]$intersect_area / total_area
          percentage_overlap_of = overlap_per_gebied[row,]$intersect_area / overlap_per_gebied[row,]$geb_area

          
          metrics_df <- data.frame(
            soort = i,
            species = paste(unique(occ_species$Species), collapse = ","), 
            abbr = unique(na.omit(occ_species$abbr)), 
            gebied = paste0("SBP ", k, " (", as.character(overlap_per_gebied[row,1]), ")"),
            overlap = format(round(c(percentage_overlap_in, percentage_overlap_of), 6), scientific = FALSE), 
            type = paste0(c("in", "of")))
          
          list.results[[j]] <- rbind(list.results[[j]], metrics_df)
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
sbp_pls_species <- c("Amerikaanse stierkikker", "Kesslergrondel", "Pontische stroomgrondel", "marmergrondel", "zwartbekgrondel", "Californische rivierkreeft", "gestreepte Amerikaanse rivierkreeft", "gevlekte Amerikaanse rivierkreeft","geknobbelde Amerikaanse rivierkreeft", "rode Amerikaanse rivierkreeft", "Turkse rivierkreeft","Chinese wolhandkrab"
) 

# Bijkomende relevante soorten uit PrIUS-II
if (radius_version == "2026_10") {

  sbp_pls_species_extra <- c(
    "blauwbandgrondel",
    "amoergrondel",
    "Noord-Aziatische modderkruiper",
    "zonnebaars",
    "zwarte dwergmeerval",
    "noordelijke slangekopvis",
    "marmerkreeft",
    "roestbruine Amerikaanse rivierkreeft",
    "Afrikaanse klauwkikker"
  )

  sbp_pls_species <- unique(c(
    sbp_pls_species,
    sbp_pls_species_extra
  ))
}

list.dfs <- list(
  SBP_pls = lu_sbp_pls_buffered,
  clusters_sbp = clusters_sbp,
  ws_bekken = WsBekken, 
  ws_deelbek = WsDeelbek
)

sbp_intersections <- list()

list.results <- lapply(list.dfs, function(x) data.frame())

for (i in sbp_pls_species) {

  print(i)

  occ_species <- occ_flanders[occ_flanders$Soort == i,]

  # Soorten zonder waarnemingen overslaan
  if (nrow(occ_species) == 0) {
    warning(paste("Geen waarnemingen voor:", i))
    next
  }

  # Afkorting bepalen, met NA indien niet beschikbaar
  abbr_value <- unique(na.omit(occ_species$abbr))

  abbr_value <- if (length(abbr_value) == 0) {
    NA_character_
  } else {
    paste(abbr_value, collapse = ", ")
  }
  
  occ_species_buf <- occ_species %>%
    st_buffer(dist = 100) %>%
    st_union() %>% 
    st_cast('POLYGON') %>% 
    st_sf() %>%
    mutate(buf_area = as.numeric(st_area(.))) 
  
  total_area <- sum(occ_species_buf$buf_area)
  
  for (j in seq_along(list.dfs[1:4])) {
    
    print(j)
    
    gebied <- list.dfs[[j]] %>%
      st_transform(31370) %>%
      mutate(geb_area = as.numeric(st_area(.)))
    
    ## Berekening metrics sbp_pls
    if (j == 1) {
      for (k in unique(gebied$soort)) {
        print(paste("SBP", k))
        
        gebied_sbp <- gebied %>%
          filter(soort == k)
        
        occ_species_intersection <- occ_species_buf %>%
          st_intersection(gebied_sbp) %>% 
          mutate(intersect_area = as.numeric(st_area(.)))
        
        sbp_intersections <- rbind(sbp_intersections, data.frame(
          occ_species_intersection %>%
            group_by(soort, type) %>%
            summarize(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>%
            mutate(intersect_area = as.numeric(st_area(.))) %>% 
            transmute(soort = i, gebied = paste("SBP ", k), type, intersect_area)
        ))
        
        overlap_intersection <- sum(occ_species_intersection$intersect_area)
        percentage_overlap_in <- overlap_intersection / total_area
        percentage_overlap_of <- overlap_intersection / sum(gebied$geb_area)
        
        overlap_intersection_al <- sum((occ_species_intersection %>% filter(type == "Actueel leefgebied"))$intersect_area)
        percentage_overlap_in_al <- overlap_intersection_al / total_area
        percentage_overlap_of_al <- overlap_intersection_al / sum(gebied$geb_area)
        
        overlap_intersection_ul <- sum((occ_species_intersection %>% filter(type == "Uitbreiding leefgebied"))$intersect_area)
        percentage_overlap_in_ul <- overlap_intersection_ul / total_area
        percentage_overlap_of_ul <- overlap_intersection_ul / sum(gebied$geb_area)
        
        metrics_df <- data.frame(
          soort = i,
          species = paste(unique(occ_species$Species), collapse = ","), 
          abbr = unique(na.omit(occ_species$abbr)),
          gebied = paste("SBP ", k),
          overlap = format(round(c(percentage_overlap_in, percentage_overlap_in_al, percentage_overlap_in_ul, percentage_overlap_of, percentage_overlap_of_al, percentage_overlap_of_ul), 6), scientific = FALSE), 
          type = paste0(c("in_sbp", "in_sbp_al", "in_sbp_ul", "of_sbp", "of_sbp_al", "of_sbp_ul"))) 
        
        metrics_df$gebied <- ifelse(metrics_df$type %in% c("in_sbp_al", "of_sbp_al"), paste(metrics_df$gebied, "(Actueel leefgebied)"),
                                    ifelse(metrics_df$type %in% c("in_sbp_ul", "of_sbp_ul"), paste(metrics_df$gebied, "(Uitbreiding leefgebied)"),
                                           metrics_df$gebied))
        
        list.results[[j]] <- rbind(list.results[[j]], metrics_df)
      }
    }
    
    ## Berekening metrics sbp waterclusters
    else if (j == 2) {
      occ_species_intersection <- occ_species_buf %>%
        st_intersection(gebied) %>% 
        mutate(intersect_area = as.numeric(st_area(.)))
      
      overlap_intersection <- sum(occ_species_intersection$intersect_area)
      percentage_overlap_in <- overlap_intersection / total_area
      percentage_overlap_of <- overlap_intersection / sum(gebied$geb_area)
      
      metrics_df <- data.frame(
        soort = i,
        species = paste(unique(occ_species$Species), collapse = ","), 
        abbr = unique(na.omit(occ_species$abbr)),
        gebied = "clusters",
        overlap = format(round(c(percentage_overlap_in, percentage_overlap_of), 6), scientific = FALSE), 
        type = paste0(c("in_clust", "of_clust"))) 
      
      list.results[[j]] <- rbind(list.results[[j]], metrics_df)
      
      overlap_per_cluster <- occ_species_intersection %>%
        group_by(CLUSTERNAAM) %>%
        summarise(intersect_area = sum(intersect_area)) %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        full_join(gebied, by = "CLUSTERNAAM") %>%
        na.replace(0)
      
      for (row in 1:nrow(overlap_per_cluster)) {
        
        percentage_overlap_in = overlap_per_cluster[row,]$intersect_area / total_area
        percentage_overlap_of = overlap_per_cluster[row,]$intersect_area / overlap_per_cluster[row,]$geb_area
        
        metrics_df <- data.frame(
          soort = i,
          species = paste(unique(occ_species$Species), collapse = ","), 
          abbr = unique(na.omit(occ_species$abbr)), 
          gebied = as.character(overlap_per_cluster[row,1]),
          overlap = format(round(c(percentage_overlap_in, percentage_overlap_of), 6), scientific = FALSE), 
          type = paste0(c("in_clust", "of_clust")))
        
        list.results[[j]] <- rbind(list.results[[j]], metrics_df)
      }
    }
    
    ## Berekening metrics bekken
    else if (j == 3) {
      occ_species_intersection <- occ_species_buf %>%
        st_intersection(gebied) %>% 
        mutate(intersect_area = as.numeric(st_area(.)))
      
      overlap_intersection <- sum(occ_species_intersection$intersect_area)
      percentage_overlap_in <- overlap_intersection / total_area
      percentage_overlap_of <- overlap_intersection / sum(gebied$geb_area)
      
      metrics_df <- data.frame(
        soort = i,
        species = paste(unique(occ_species$Species), collapse = ","), 
        abbr = unique(na.omit(occ_species$abbr)),
        gebied = "bekken",
        overlap = format(round(c(percentage_overlap_in, percentage_overlap_of), 6), scientific = FALSE), 
        type = paste0(c("in_bek", "of_bek"))) 
      
      list.results[[j]] <- rbind(list.results[[j]], metrics_df)
      
      overlap_per_bekken <- occ_species_intersection %>%
        group_by(BEKNAAM) %>%
        summarise(intersect_area = sum(intersect_area)) %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        full_join(gebied, by = "BEKNAAM") %>%
        na.replace(0)
      
      for (row in 1:nrow(overlap_per_bekken)) {
        
        percentage_overlap_in = overlap_per_bekken[row,]$intersect_area / total_area
        percentage_overlap_of = overlap_per_bekken[row,]$intersect_area / overlap_per_bekken[row,]$geb_area
        
        metrics_df <- data.frame(
          soort = i,
          species = paste(unique(occ_species$Species), collapse = ","), 
          abbr = unique(na.omit(occ_species$abbr)), 
          gebied = as.character(overlap_per_bekken[row,1]),
          overlap = format(round(c(percentage_overlap_in, percentage_overlap_of), 6), scientific = FALSE), 
          type = paste0(c("in_bek", "of_bek")))
        
        list.results[[j]] <- rbind(list.results[[j]], metrics_df)
        
      }
    }
    
    ## Berekening metrics deelbekken
    else if (j == 4) {
      occ_species_intersection <- occ_species_buf %>%
        st_intersection(gebied) %>% 
        mutate(intersect_area = as.numeric(st_area(.)))
      
      overlap_intersection <- sum(occ_species_intersection$intersect_area)
      percentage_overlap_in <- overlap_intersection / total_area
      percentage_overlap_of <- overlap_intersection / sum(gebied$geb_area)
      
      metrics_df <- data.frame(
        soort = i,
        species = paste(unique(occ_species$Species), collapse = ","), 
        abbr = unique(na.omit(occ_species$abbr)),
        gebied = "deelbekken",
        overlap = format(round(c(percentage_overlap_in, percentage_overlap_of), 6), scientific = FALSE), 
        type = paste0(c("in_deelbek", "of_deelbek"))) 
      
      list.results[[j]] <- rbind(list.results[[j]], metrics_df)
      
      overlap_per_deelbek <- occ_species_intersection %>%
        group_by(DEELBEKNM) %>%
        summarise(intersect_area = sum(intersect_area)) %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        full_join(gebied, by = "DEELBEKNM") %>%
        na.replace(0)
      
      for (row in 1:nrow(overlap_per_deelbek)) {
        
        percentage_overlap_in = overlap_per_deelbek[row,]$intersect_area / total_area
        percentage_overlap_of = overlap_per_deelbek[row,]$intersect_area / overlap_per_deelbek[row,]$geb_area
        
        metrics_df <- data.frame(
          soort = i,
          species = paste(unique(occ_species$Species), collapse = ","), 
          abbr = unique(na.omit(occ_species$abbr)), 
          gebied = as.character(overlap_per_deelbek[row,1]),
          overlap = format(round(c(percentage_overlap_in, percentage_overlap_of), 6), scientific = FALSE), 
          type = paste0(c("in_deelbek", "of_deelbek")))
        
        list.results[[j]] <- rbind(list.results[[j]], metrics_df)
        
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r assign-results-to-df}
SBP_pls_extra <- rbind(list.results$SBP_pls, list.results$clusters_sbp, list.results$ws_bekken, list.results$ws_deelbek)

```

```{r save-dfs-in-long-format}
write_csv(
  SBP_pls_extra,
  here::here("radius", "data", "output", radius_version, "SBP_pls_extra.csv"),
  append = FALSE
)

st_write(
  sbp_intersections %>% st_as_sf(),
  here::here("radius", "data", "output", radius_version, "sbp_pls_intersects.shp"),
  append = FALSE
)
```
